title: IngestEvent
description: What `mesh serve` admits on /ingest. Missing optional fields take defaults (mode defaults to SIMULATED). The server assigns run_id, seq, and tick when it records the event, and rejects messages over 64 KiB or above the per-connection rate limit.

event_type.description: The only event types accepted from outside the kernel. Proposals, validations, judgments, and commitments cannot be injected.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds. Logical simulation time in experiments; wall time is in provenance.json.

source.description: For LIVE data this must be a source registered in MESH_LIVE_SOURCES.

correlation_id.description: Groups every event of one decision.

causation_id.description: event_id of the direct cause, or the run config hash for the first event.

provenance.description: Component version and, where applicable, the evidence the event was derived from.

mode.description: SIMULATED, LIVE, or REPLAY. Unlabeled data defaults to SIMULATED.

ai_involved.description: True when a probabilistic or remote model produced or influenced the event.

payload.description: For human_state: {"datum": HumanStateDatum}, with datum.mode equal to the envelope mode.

payload_json.description: Legacy v1.0 form: the payload as a JSON string.
